title: cirsium eriophorum var. costae
intro: Cirsium eriophorum var. costae, commonly known as a type of thistle, is a plant species found in the mountainous regions of North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant health benefits, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Cirsium eriophorum var. costae include its ability to modulate immune response, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
